name: linux-openshell-unsupported-consumers
reason: The current OpenShell command wrapper supports foreground Bash only. Linux PTC FD7 control, persistent/browser PTY streaming, guest foreground facts and concurrent process ownership are unjoined; those consumers require aukoraConfinement then refuse before child launch, including custom shell argv and direct runtime.run callers. Apply after mandatory-agent-confinement, without widening file enforcement.
